target_customer: AI labs buying custom video and multimodal training datasets
problem: Labs need large, specific, labeled video datasets and getting them by manual collection takes months.
business_model: Custom dataset sales and a self serve data platform called RecipeBook
product_category: AI training data, video index and labeling

founders.name: Braiden Dishman
founders.role: CEO per YC page, COO per launch post

founders.name: Andre Braga
education: BS in Statistics and Data Science, UCSB
founders.background_notes: YC page says previously at MIT.

founders.name: Alexzendor Misra
previous_startups: Correkt, AI search engine with 43k users (per YC page)

competitors.name: Troveo
competitors.what: Licenses creator video to AI developers
competitors.traction_then: Reported paying over $20M to content owners by April 2026

competitors.name: Protege
competitors.what: Brokers content licensing deals for AI training
competitors.traction_then: Protege Media reports more than 100 media partners

competitors.name: Wirestock
competitors.what: Creator marketplace supplying licensed multimodal data

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing billions of videos and running agentic search and labeling is heavy infrastructure work, but built from existing models and tools.

defensibility.rationale: The index could compound, but sourcing from public web video faces legal risk and competitors hold licensed content relationships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Data vendors were already selling video datasets. No Shofo specific response is public.

market_need_then: AI labs were paying creators and brokers for video in 2025 and 2026, and lawsuits over scraped YouTube video raised the value of cleared data.

identity.voice_and_tone: Ambitious, claims world's largest video library

branding.brand_signature: Claim of the world's largest video library
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt style coverage of RecipeBook launch and a trade piece calling it Common Crawl for video

brand_strength.rationale: A few trade write ups exist but no source covers the brand itself, and the RecipeBook name collides with unrelated recipe apps.

outcome_analysis: Shofo joined YC in Winter 2026 and has no exit or failure. It sells custom labeled video datasets and launched RecipeBook, but names no customers and funding figures conflict across aggregators. The founders previously ran Correkt, an AI search product, which helps with indexing. Legal exposure around scraped video and established licensing rivals are the main risks.
notes: Funding unverified: one aggregator says $130,000 seed in January 2026, another says $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with Sahin Boydas as an investor, no primary source, so no round recorded. YC page is inconsistent on whether Braiden Dishman is CEO or COO, with Bryan Hong named CEO in the launch post but not confirmed as a founder. Outcome search found no lawsuit against Shofo. Completeness pass: three rounds recorded, each resting on a single database or outlet (CB Insights seed 2026-04 with xNova VC and a stated total of $500K over 3 rounds, VCBacked pre-seed 2026-03, YesPress $130K seed 2026-01). They conflict and may describe the same financing, so amounts are not summed; no press release or filing confirms any. No co-founder added.
